assumption_provenance: Original-scale MCA in-vitro low-pressure perfusion simulation; flow, ideal independent propulsion and lysis rate are engineering settings, NOT measured hardware or in-vivo physiology
action_frame: world; policy Frenet action transformed once at the control boundary
actuation: independent ideal velocity actuators; shared magnetic field NOT implemented
lysis_provenance: 0.36 normalized mass/s is the old 0.018/step under a hypothetical 50ms period; an explicit synthetic test rate, NOT measured thrombolysis kinetics
contact_provenance: Reaction gap 0.04 mm between finite robot surface and interpolated stenosis lumen wall, within 3 sigma of the wall-defining Gaussian; one target per robot; no adhesion
particle_model: passive finite-size tracers in the same pressure flow; proximity/overlap diagnostics only, no hydrodynamic or collision forces
lubrication_provenance: 1.0 disables uncalibrated thrust loss; optimistic ideal-velocity dynamics, not a validated force model
numerical_method: endpoint-limited projected midpoint substeps; one-sided incident-edge crossing and aperture checks; convergence audit required; no flow cap and no artificial minimum lumen radius
boundary_condition: open absorbing inlet and leaf outlets; lost robots cannot reappear or remove clot
initialization_description: Each episode: shuffled navigable branches without replacement; length-weighted edge, radial offset <=65% of clearance; reject overlaps and invalid lumen projections. No clot-target bias.
flow_provenance: Driving pressure calibrated to a HEALTHY-tree reference flow of 0.01 mL/min (10 uL/min). Actual obstructed flow is solved, not held constant. Deliberate controlled in-vitro baseline, NOT physiological MCA flow.
horizon_provenance: 180 s permits navigation across nominal anatomy at 1 mm/s plus sustained contact; validated through exact simulator before launch
success_definition: All four normalized masses reach zero; same absorbing boundaries, no teleportation, no automatic target clearing
reward_provenance: Potential shaping gamma*Phi(next)-Phi(now), Phi=-0.3*distance_mm, zero potential for lost robots/all-clear, bootstrap at time limit; no oracle actions or demonstrations
